Bus Overturns in Mahbubnagar, Injuring 20 Passengers

A private travels bus overturned on National Highway 44 in Mahbubnagar, resulting in injuries to approximately 20 passengers. Four individuals sustained critical injuries, while a total of 10 passengers were reported injured in the incident. The exact cause of the accident is not specified in the coverage.
